# Duel

## Purpose
The ghost race on the server: finds an opponent's recorded run for a level the player has reached, or a bot, and files the player's won run for others to race. Calls the Leaderboard Cloud Code module's FindDuel and SubmitDuel.

## Concepts
duel, ghost race, pvp, opponent, versus, düello, IDuelService, FindDuel, SubmitDuel
